answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded summit, and peers read the reasoning. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the opal of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Net effect on the ivory: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1nkul.
